name: Understand-Anything
tagline_zh: 把代码变成可探索的知识图谱，能搜能问。不是静态图，是能对话的活地图——连注释里的梗都给你标出来。
tagline_en: Turn code into a living knowledge graph you can search, explore, and ask questions about—even the jokes in.
desc_en: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works wit
why_zh: 同类只画依赖关系，它把语义也织进图里，问它“为什么这里要重试”能答出上下文。
why_en: Others draw dependency lines; it weaves semantics in, so you can ask 'why retry here?' and get context.
